blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The P575.94 million Ultra Lotto 6/58 jackpot was not won in the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) draw on Sunday, Nov. 22, 2026. The P126.81 million jackpot of the Super Lotto 6/49, which was the other major lotto game drawn on Sunday was not also won. According to the PCSO results, the Ultra Lotto 6/58 draw produced the winning combination 05-51-44-55-32-21, with a jackpot prize of P575.94 million. No ticket holder matched all six numbers.
